Concept: The perfect collar. An exquisite close-up of a pristine ivory cotton shirt collar, opened naturally with mother-of-pearl buttons; another pale blue striped folded shirt beside it and subtle sage swatches beneath. Sophisticated eye-level macro composition, immaculate sartorial details filling the photograph with few elements, wine thread spool small discreet accent in lower right.
